articles.title: Alyssa Grace、パーソナルで繊細な新曲リリース

articles.translatedTitle: Alyssa Grace releases personal and sensitive new song
articles.translatedExcerpt: Alyssa Grace released her new single "washing skin" on Friday, November 6, 2026. This work is more personal than ever, as she confronts the painful events she experienced in the past and the trauma deeply engraved in her heart. Through delicate musical expressions based on folk pop, he frankly depicts the experiences of hurt and the complex emotions that arise from them. This song was released by Artist House. The song is based on an acoustic sound and uses cinematic production. Release information https://ototoy.jp/_/default/p/4414203 Artist information https://www.instagram.com/alyssagracesings/

articles.translatedTitle: Megan Moroney releases new acoustic song
articles.translatedExcerpt: Megan Moroney released her new single "You for Me (Smoky Mountain Demo)" on Friday, November 6, 2026. This song sings about the feeling that even though you have beautiful scenery and gorgeous experiences all over the world, what you are truly yearning for is only one person. The song is an acoustic number depicting earnest romantic feelings. This song is different from her 2026 album "Cloud 9", which incorporates a gorgeous pop sound, and highlights her charm as a songwriter. The simple sound of the guitar and the vocals that carefully convey emotions make it an impressive song. articles.translatedTitle: nomi., new AL release containing 11 songs
articles.translatedExcerpt: nomi. released their new album ``This Wolf May Cry'' on Friday, October 30, 2026. She has attracted attention from SZA, Tyler, The Creator, Pharrell Williams, Kaytranada, and more. This is a full-length album that brings to fruition the musical identity that has been presented little by little through singles and EPs. Although it has a compact composition of 11 songs, approximately 30 minutes, it traverses modern R&B, neo-soul, alternative pop, and even a rhythm reminiscent of UK garage. With a soft, floating singing voice and a production with a unique blank space, it is a work that invites the listener to a slightly mysterious world of music. articles.translatedTitle: shosha releases introspective new song “Anchor”
articles.translatedExcerpt: shosha released a new single "Anchor" on Wednesday, November 4, 2026. This is his fourth work since the beginning of this year, and it is a song that introspectively depicts the process of being in the midst of love and heading towards its end. The song's lyrics are based on the contradictions and conflicts between the desire to hold back the person who is leaving and the resignation that is accepting the ending, and the title ``Anchor'' is a metaphor for trying to hold on to the heart of someone who is leaving. The sound is a pop-oriented liquid drum and bass. Layering whispering vocal samples, gentle felt piano chords, and a low, crawling Reese bass, they create a quiet yet propulsive beat. Additionally, the album will be released on November 25th (Wednesday). It is scheduled to include a total of 8 songs, including previously released songs that have been released since September.

articles.translatedTitle: NEK! to perform at Taiwanese music festival <Ukigensai EMERGE FEST 2027>
articles.translatedExcerpt: It has been decided that NEK! will appear at the music festival <Ukigensai EMERGE FEST 2027> to be held in Taiwan. EMERGE FEST 2027, which will be held on February 20th and 21st, 2027 at Qingshui Weifengshan Sports Park in Taichung, Taiwan, will bring together up-and-coming rock acts from all over Asia, and is one of Taiwan's best outdoor festivals, with tickets selling out for six consecutive years. This will be NEK!'s first appearance at a major overseas festival. Furthermore, in Japan, they will be holding a nationwide tour called ``NEK! LIVE TOUR 2027'', which will include 12 performances in 11 locations nationwide, starting with the ESAKA MUSE performance in Osaka on January 10, 2027. The tour will include Hika's hometown of Nagasaki and her first one-man live in Hokkaido, which will be her first foray into the area, and the final will be held in Ebisu, Tokyo on March 22nd.

In preparation for Aina The End's longest hall tour, which will include 22 performances in 19 cities, including Taipei, which was recently lifted, Aina The End is looking for chorus and dancers to work with them to create the stage with the aim of further improving their live performance. In order to give top priority to the quality of the stage, the screening will proceed through a careful selection process, with the policy of not hiring applicants if there are no suitable candidates. In addition to Aina The End herself, the judges include Yukannu, a chorus and dancer who has supported Aina's solo activities since the beginning. Successful candidates will also receive guidance and rehearsals in preparation for the actual performance. Click here for details on recruitment requirements and how to apply https://ainatheend.jp/news/detail.php?id=113…

articles.translatedTitle: Jun Togawa and Yapoos release 1985 live video of global viral hit “Suki, Suki, Isai”
articles.translatedExcerpt: The 1985 live video of Jun Togawa and Yapooz's song ``Suki suki sai sai'' has been remastered and restored in HD and released. "Suki Suki Aishi" is an unusual love song released by Jun Togawa in 1985. Coupled with the shocking phrase "If you don't say I love you, I'll kill you," which he wrote himself, has long earned him a strong following, and in recent years, he has become a global viral hit thanks to overseas TikTok, and the number of new listeners across borders is increasing exponentially every day. Just in time for Halloween, the live video was uploaded on YouTube and the Chinese video site bilibili's Alpha Music official channel. The video is an excerpt from a live performance performed by Jun Togawa and Yapoos on November 28, 1985 at the Osaka Welfare Pension Hall, and has already been commercialized as TOUR-LIVE '85-'86.

articles.translatedTitle: Ado will release the opening song “Shinka” for the anime “Demon’s Crest”
articles.translatedExcerpt: Ado's new song ``Shinka'', which has been selected as the opening theme for the anime ``Demon's Crest'', which will be distributed exclusively worldwide on Prime Video from 21:00 on Friday, November 6, 2026, will be distributed on Friday, November 6, the same day as the anime distribution start date. "Shinka" is a new song written by Vocaloid P Yuurii Kanon, who has been in contact with Ado for some time. It depicts the desire to believe in one's own voice and expression in a world covered in lies and fiction, where even life and people's will is looked down upon. The emotional melody and lively sound overlap to powerfully express determination for growth and hope for the future. The song is a mix of delicate emotions and dynamic development, making it a song that will help each listener's ``evolution.'' This is an up-tempo song that is close to the worldview of anime where "reality" and "game" invade each other...

articles.translatedTitle: HY announces third round of performers for Okinawa outdoor festival <HY SKY Fes 2027 & Eve Festival>. OZworld, Mika Nakashima and others to appear
articles.translatedExcerpt: HY has announced the third group of artists who will be performing at his outdoor festival <HY SKY Fes 2027>. It has been decided that OZworld, a rapper born and raised in Okinawa, singer Mika Nakashima, who will celebrate her 25th anniversary this year, will perform on the eve of the event, Okinawan vocal duo D-51, Kochi rock band THE Stereo Gang for the opening act, and RYU, a junior high school student who has been attracting attention for his street live performances in Chatan, Okinawa. The 8th ``HY SKY Fes 2027 & Eve Festival'' will be held for three days at the Okinawa Prefectural Sports Park Multipurpose Square, with the eve festival on March 19th, Day 1 on the 20th, and Day 2 on the 21st. This festival, which features artists that HY wants to invite and artists who agree with the concept and planning of the festival, will continue to feature genre-less artists in 2027.

articles.translatedExcerpt: Da-iCE has released the lyric video for ``Uraraka,'' the theme song for Fuji TV's Thursday Theater ``Nami Urarakani, Meoto Biyori.'' articles.translatedTitle: syudou releases MV for pre-released song “Dattesa” from 2nd album “UKA”
articles.translatedExcerpt: The music video for syudou's new song "Dattesa", which was just pre-released from his 2nd album "UKA", has been released. This MV is a collaboration between Yastatu and Kurome, who have worked on numerous syudou MVs, and is the first collaboration since ``Life Tsuna''. Popular characters also appear in the video, and combined with the worldview of syudou's lyrics, the video has an impact. Syudou will release his second album ``UKA'' next week on November 4th, his first in about three and a half years. On the release day, a DJ event will be held at Shibuya HARLEM as a release party, bringing together DJs with ties to the album, and a collaborative performance by each DJ and syudou will also be held. On the day of the event, there will be a "UKA" release celebration party, and if you purchase "UKA" at the event venue, you will receive a gift directly from Syudou himself.

articles.translatedTitle: Ado, anime “Demon’s Crest” opening theme “Shinka” will be distributed
articles.translatedExcerpt: Ado has announced that his new song "Shinka" will be released on November 6, 2026. This song will be used as the opening theme for the anime ``Demon's Crest'', which will be distributed exclusively worldwide on Prime Video from 9pm on the same day as the release date, and is a new song written by Vocaloid P Yuurii Kanon, who has been in contact with Ado for some time. This work depicts the desire to believe in one's own voice and expression in a world covered in lies and fiction, where even life and human will are looked down upon. The emotional melody and lively sound overlap, powerfully expressing determination to grow and hope for the future. The song is said to be an up-tempo song in which delicate emotions and dynamic development intertwine, and while it is close to the ``evolution'' of each listener, it is also in line with the worldview of anime where ``reality'' and ``games'' invade each other.

articles.translatedTitle: Toshio Kadomatsu, 45th anniversary of debut live video work to be released
articles.translatedExcerpt: TOSHIKI KADOMATSU 45th Anniversary Live, held at Yokohama Arena in Kanagawa on June 27, 2026, will be released as Blu-ray and DVD on January 1, 2027. Toshio Kadomatsu, who has been at the forefront of the Japanese music scene for 45 years, condensed his musical life to date and created an evening with an eye on the future. The stage that filled the Yokohama Arena with excitement and excitement has been revived as a video work. While consolidating their activities over the past five years, they will connect the music they have created in the 45 years since their debut, the people they have met, and the experiences they have accumulated in a single line, leading to the next era. articles.translatedTitle: Baby Canta releases new song “Shooting Star”
articles.translatedExcerpt: Baby Canta has decided to release their new song "Shooting Star" on November 11th. The new song "Shooting Star" opens with a cheerful and impressive guitar riff, and the horn section and guitar overlap with a tight beat, creating a pleasant groove that leaves an impression. With an organic sound make-up, it is a night cruising city pop song that combines a shooting star that flashes through the night sky with a fleeting hope for tomorrow. Following the previous work "NPC", this work is completely self-produced by Baby Canta, who not only wrote and composed the lyrics but also produced it.
